name: personalearn
description: personaLearn e-learning platform with AI recommendation

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
